533001.name: Leg Laser
533001.description:
Fires a laser from Kraken's hind leg at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Attack the Cancel Ring to deal damage to the hind leg.
Generates a code barrier to defend against attacks while the Cancel Ring is active. While the barrier is up, only Iron Code Nikkes can deal damage.

533002.name: Squid Missile
533002.description:
Fires many Squid Missiles at a single Nikke, dealing damage.
Missiles can be intercepted.

533003.name: Focus Laser
533003.description: Fires a laser, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

533004.name: Big Leg Laser
533004.description:
Fires a laser from Kraken's front leg that can pierce through cover, dealing damage to a single Nikke.
Attack Cancel Ring to deal damage to the front leg.

533009.name: Tidal Wave
533009.description: Kraken stirs up massive waves, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

533010.name: High-Power Focus Laser
533010.description: Fires a high-power laser at a single Nikke, dealing damage.

533011.name: Hydro Cannon
533011.description: Kraken inhales the surrounding seawater and shoots it out, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

533012.name: Big Leg Smash
533012.description: Kraken vigorously waves its front leg, dealing damage to all Nikkes.
